description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Spellstrike], [Damage Cap +10000], [Switch Draw Mode (Wind, Dark)] and [Cruel Blow Follow-up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Spellstrike
description.text: Wind and Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Switch Draw Mode (Wind, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Dark] after using a Wind/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Cruel Blow Follow-up
description.text: Casts Cruel Blow after using three Wind or Dark abilities
